rule: Maximum mean of 10 paired percentages vs local; within 1e-9 percentage points use lower mean escalation_seconds then lexical arm ID. Rank all candidates before checking the winner's genuine joint evidence.
genuine_joint_definition: Committed positive witness inserting exactly two distinct outside vertices, both pre-commit unary gains <=0; instrumented native event evidence bound to unchanged source/binary hashes.
resource_policy: All audited native quality results retained; CPU/wall flags do not exclude pairs
quality_scope: Development observations on 10 prespecified graph-seed pairs from one physical mother source
tolerance_arithmetic: Mean paired percentages and the 1e-9 percentage-point boundary are compared as exact rational numbers from integer ticks; displayed values are floats.
